profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Samsung Healthcare USA

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Leading software design and software architecture for flagship products
-Primary contact for company’s Unity software development
-Responsible for the development of a main component of the OmniTom
-Led R&D project for self-driving using computer vision
-Worked with customers directly to resolve issues on the field
-Provided assistance in other areas of development that needed help
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python · Agile Methodologies · C# · Linux · Computer Vision · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · .NET Framework · Embedded C++ · Scrum · SQL · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Machine Learning · Image Processing · GitHub · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Data Structures · OpenCV · Continuous Integration (CI) · Unity3D

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
• Contributed to UI functionality and usability for Swing Strikers
• Integrated character and skin selection/customization into gameplay
• Wrote gameplay mechanics for characters in Swing Strikers
• Addressed bugs to unblock the team and improve gameplay
• Collaborated remotely with team members to ensure a seamless development process
positions.insights: Skills: Zenject · Unity3D · C# · Debugging · Gameplay Programming · UI Programming

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
-Translate design requirements using Unity
-Collaborated with a designer and web developer to bring our games to life
-Provide engineering support for game live operations
-Contribute original input and ideas
-Helped Website Developers implement educational games and animations on the company website
-Took the initiative to make creative recommendations that accomplish the goals of the games
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · GitHub · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Data Structures

positions.title: Lead Unity Developer
positions.description:
• Working with Unity 2019.1, developed for Android and iOS
• Mobile game autorun game with obstacles, enemies, and a physical-to-digital toy system
• Created code-based state machine in conjunction with Unity animation state system
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · GitHub · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Data Structures

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description: Skills: GitHub · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Data Structures

positions.title: Developer / Producer / Designer
positions.description:
- Developing with Reworld Engine: Unity-based, Roblox-esque engine; developed for mobile and PC
- Obstacle course where players split into teams and run from a heatwave to escape the island 
- Presented initial game idea and helped with the design process throughout the project
- Ran scrum meetings, maintained list of goals with dates and labels, and assigned them
- Analyzed milestones and needs to adjust weekly goals properly
- Wrote code for team boost mechanic, lobby/game logic, UI logic, audio on server and client sides

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
*Manage and update our WordPress website
*Interview new coaching talent to join the team
*Work directly with coaches on the website
*Social media posts (i.e. Twitter, Facebook)
*E-Sports Team Manager

positions.title: Junior Game Developer
positions.description:
Iron Man VR
- Worked with Unity 2018.3 VR, and developed for PSVR and multiple VR platforms
- Reproduced bugs for submission using Perforce
- Helped complete cross-input manager for VR and Unity debugging
- Developed, modified, and tested new Unity tools to support the team
- Worked on a large team of engineers, used Jira and Scrum to complete tasks
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Data Structures

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: I taught teens the fundamentals of C++, Python, game design, Unreal Engine 4, Unity, C#, and Maya. As my students created more complex projects with their new-found knowledge, I would assist them in any roadblocks that arrived.  I was also a trusted member of the iDTech Princeton team, taking on more roles and providing solutions to issues that would arise as a new member of the team. The Regional Manager recommended me to be hired at iDTech USF (Tampa, FL).

volunteerExperiences.description: At the Inter-Generational volunteer opportunity, we went to houses of the elderly and raked their houses.

volunteerExperiences.role: Video Game Tournament for the Boys and Girls Club of America
volunteerExperiences.description: I created, organized, and ran a tournament for my fraternities' philanthropy, The Boys and Girls Club of America. I advertised and got a sponsorship for the event. It was a success, and is the first event I have ran on my own.

organizations.name: Men of Color, Honor, and Ambition (M.O.C.H.A)
organizations.description: Leadership development, professionalism, and financial development group. Year long sessions dedicated to members for self-improvement and network building.

organizations.name: Phi Kappa Psi
organizations.description: Organization built on serving others; Phi Kappa Psi New York Theta does weekly community service and hosts large events raising thousands of dollars for local companies like Hillside Family Agencies and the Veteran Outreach of Rochester for years.
